title: A prior review's one-line fix empties a list the consuming schema requires to hold one item, so applying it stops every publish

planted.why: the fix leaves sources empty; the schema requires minItems 1 and publish.py stops the whole publish on a validation error; the fix was never run against the validator, and an approved replacement exists

proof.python:
import json
s = json.load(open('schema/manifest.schema.json'))
assert s['properties']['sources']['minItems'] == 1
r = open('review.md').read()
assert '"sources": []' in r and 'validate' not in r
assert 'stops the whole publish' in open('publish.md').read()
